name: MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc.
blurb: MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. designs and manufactures analog semiconductor solutions for wireless and wireline applications across RF, microwave, millimeter wave, and lightwave spectrum. Its product portfolio includes integrated circuits, multi-chip modules, diodes, amplifiers, switches, and subsystems used in telecommunications, data center, industrial, and defense markets. The company has a market capitalization of approximately $25.8 billion and is recognized as a key player in high-performance analog semiconductors.
recent: In the past 30 days, MACOM reported fiscal Q1 results that beat sales targets, causing the stock to surge 16.5% in a single session. The stock reached a 52-week high of $355.00 on May 7, 2026, and has gained over 244% in the past year. Analysts maintain a Strong Buy consensus with a price target of $272.60, though the stock currently trades above that level.
